articles.summary: Six Flags Entertainment Corporation (NYSE: FUN), the largest regional amusement park operator in North America, said today it will issue 2026 third-quarter results in the pre-market hours of Thursday, November 5, 2026. Starting at 8 a.m. EST that day, Six Flags management will host a conference call for the investment community to provide additional details regarding third-quarter results and discuss the Company’s business outlook. Management participants on the call will include Six Flags CEO John Reilly and CFO Ash Walia. Investors and all other interested parties can access a live, listen-only audio webcast of the call on the Six Flags investor website https://investors.sixflags.com under the tabs Investor Information / Events Presentations. Those unable to listen to the live webcast can visit our investor website where we will post a playback shortly after the live call’s conclusion.
